scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @leadwork/contracts build && pnpm --filter @leadwork/engine build && pnpm --filter @leadwork/providers build && pnpm --filter @leadwork/core build
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @leadwork/web build && pnpm --filter @leadwork/worker build
scripts.test:unit: node --test packages/contracts/test/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @leadwork/engine test && pnpm --filter @leadwork/providers test && pnpm --filter @leadwork/web test
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && pnpm test:unit && node scripts/test-core.mjs
